from collections import deque
seen=set(); Gps=[]
for p_ in ps:
    if p_ in seen: continue
    q=collections.deque([p_]); comp=set()
    seen.add(p_)
    while q:
        r,c=q.popleft(); comp.add((r,c))
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            if (rr,cc) in ps and (rr,cc) not in seen: seen.add((rr,cc)); q.append((rr,cc))
    Gps.append(comp)
print(len(Gps)); [print(c) for c in Gps]
